title: Audit dead configuration in system.yaml — remove or implement
description:
**Severity: LOW**

**File**: `config/system.yaml`

Multiple configuration sections are entirely disabled/empty with no clear indication whether the backing code exists:

1. **experiment** (lines 61-64): `enabled: false`, empty name, empty buckets — feature status unknown.
2. **integrations** (lines 65-85): github, gitlab, slack, jira all `enabled: false` — are these implemented?
3. **observability.otel** (lines 91-97): OpenTelemetry disabled, empty endpoint — is OTEL supported?
4. **grafana** (lines 98-102): All URLs empty — is Grafana integration implemented?
5. **alerting** (lines 103-111): PagerDuty and Slack alerting disabled — is this implemented?
6. **context.redaction_policies** (line 60): Always empty `{}` — is redaction implemented?
7. **models.model_preferences / model_cost_limits** (lines 50-51): Empty `{}` — are these implemented?

Also in `config/safety.yaml`:
8. **mcp allow/deny lists** (lines 10-20): All lists empty — is MCP filtering implemented?

**Fix**: For each section, grep the codebase to determine if code exists:
- If code exists: keep config, add comments explaining the feature.
- If no code exists: remove the dead config to reduce confusion.
- If code is planned: add a `# TODO: not yet implemented` comment.
definitionOfDone: Each dead config section audited against codebase
Unimplemented sections either removed or marked with TODO comments
Implemented but disabled sections have clear documentation

implementationPlan.description:
**Audit results**:

| Config Section | Code Exists? | Action |
|---|---|---|
| experiment | config model only, no runtime | Add `# TODO: not yet implemented` |
| integrations (github/gitlab/slack/jira) | config model only, no runtime | Add `# TODO: not yet implemented` |
| observability.otel | None at all | Add `# TODO: not yet implemented` |
| grafana | None at all | Add `# TODO: not yet implemented` |
| alerting (pagerduty/slack) | None at all | Add `# TODO: not yet implemented` |
| redaction_policies | safety_policy.go — implemented | Keep, add comment |
| model_preferences | Struct field only, never used | Remove from struct |
| model_cost_limits | Struct field only, never used | Remove from struct |
| mcp allow/deny | Safety kernel — implemented | Keep, add comment |

In `config/system.yaml`, add `# TODO: not yet implemented` comments to the 5 unimplemented sections: experiment, integrations, otel, grafana, alerting. Add `# Used by safety kernel` comments to redaction_policies and models sections.
Remove unused struct fields `ModelPreferences` and `ModelCostLimits` from `core/infra/config/categories.go:97,100` since they're defined but never referenced by any runtime code.
Remove the corresponding empty `model_preferences: {}` and `model_cost_limits: {}` entries from `config/system.yaml`.
In `config/safety.yaml`, add comments to the MCP allow/deny lists noting they're used by the safety kernel for MCP filtering.
Run `go build ./...` and `go test ./core/infra/config/...` to verify no build/test failures from removed struct fields.
